idea: Monday slot 2 Healthy habits – WASH YOUR HANDS (BATHROOM, Ava in HOME outfit, on the wooden step stool at the white sink): hook 'Oh no! Messy hands!' – Ava holds up both palms covered with red, blue and green crayon scribbles beside her face, big gasp; SOAP: 'Soap, soap! Bubbles, bubbles!' – she rubs foamy hands, bubbles float up; copy-me 'Rub, rub, rub your hands!'; WATER: 'Water, water! Splash, splash, splash!' – she rinses under the tap, hands clean; TOWEL: 'Towel, towel! Pat, pat, dry!' – she pats dry with the fluffy yellow towel; chorus 'Wash, wash, wash your hands!'; question to the viewer 'Before we eat, what do we do? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'Wash our hands! Yay!'; lesson 'Clean hands for me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now CLEAN palms beside her face, bubbles floating, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh No! Messy Hands! 🧼 Wash Your Hands with Baby Ava | Healthy Habits | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Ava's hands are covered in crayon colors! 🖍️ Sing along with Ava in the bathroom and learn to wash your hands in three easy steps: soap, water and a fluffy towel.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! Messy hands!" – red, blue and green crayon on Ava's hands
🧼 Soap, soap! Bubbles, bubbles! – rub, rub, rub your hands with Ava!
💧 Water, water! Splash, splash, splash!
✨ Towel, towel! Pat, pat, dry!
🤔 "Before we eat, what do we do?" – can you say it? WASH OUR HANDS!
👋 Clean hands for me! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: washing hands step by step • wash before we eat • soap • water • towel • bubbles • clean hands

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun hand-washing song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Ava stands on her little step stool at the bathroom sink, gets her messy crayon hands foamy with soap, rinses them with water and pats them dry with a yellow towel – a happy healthy habit to copy at home before every meal.
